verdict.rationale: First-party docs show schema-driven structured extraction, not just raw text. `page.extract` accepts a JSON schema, `page.agent.run_task` accepts a `data_extraction_schema`, and tasks can take an optional JSON schema for structured output. missing for 10: explicit documentation that outputs are validated against the schema, native Zod/Pydantic model support (only raw JSON schema is shown), independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
